title: The Orchard Cafe
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The orchard café of Appleton closed the year Mira and Jack divorced; the apples kept growing. Five years later, Jack's contractor crew is hired to demolish the café, and Mira — now the architect on the project — has to design its replacement. The orchard has one condition of its own: the oldest tree is still bearing.
